Jio Launches New Anniversary Plan with 1000GB Data Offer

Jio has launched a new anniversary plan to mark its 10 years, offering 1000GB of data for a year. The plan, priced at ₹3,599, provides 2.5GB of data daily for 365 days, along with unlimited calling and SMS benefits.
